---
title: "Cite"
---

Use [`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/piyush314/gauge-floors/blob/main/CITATION.cff)
through GitHub's **Cite this repository** control. Cite the companion study whose
method, result, or artifact you use.

The nuclear-floor preprint is available from
[HAL Open Science](https://hal.science/hal-05711980). Citation metadata for the
product-aware rounding study is included in the CFF record and will be updated
when its public identifier is available.

Repository citation dates and versions describe the computational artifact,
not the publication status of either study.
